title: Challenge
description: server -> device, sent after a schema-valid hello for a device_id the server has a registered public key for. nonce is base64-encoded random bytes the device must sign with its Keystore private key (device-registration.schema.json) and return in a challenge_response. Not sent at all if device_id is unknown — the server closes the connection instead (see droidthumb-server's ws-server.ts close codes).
